Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Mind Control

On his max upgrade, Lulu (Emperor) can make enemies within his range walk back for a couple of seconds. This includes bosses, which makes him a good support unit. Stun/Freeze/Walkback/knockback and similar effects can't stack, and there is a 1s delay before an enemy can be affected again

  • Duration: 5s
  • Cooldown: 40s
  • delay before another walkback can be used on the same enemy is 50 seconds
  • this effect scales of enemy speed so make sure not to use it when enemy is stunned or slowed

Selling

This unit cannot be sold.

Trivia

  • This is the very first Secret unit, as he is released upon the game's released. He was followed by Fire Fist on Update 1.
  • This is the only Secret unit that is summonable and the first one that doesn't start out as a MythicalMythical.
